caption: The drawing depicts a spiked helmet, primarily colored in dark shades, likely black or dark blue, with gold detailing. The helmet features a tall, pointed spike on the top and ornate metallic embellishments at the base of the spike. On the front of the helmet, there is a gold emblem comprising an eagle with outstretched wings perched atop a rectangular shield. Inside the shield is the number "23" and below the shield is a banner containing text. A gold-colored decorative chain runs across the front brim of the helmet, attached at either side. The image is set against a plain, light-colored background and is framed by a rectangular outline. In the bottom right corner outside of the outlined frame, there is a signature reading “A. Fastovsky.”
title: Full Dress Helmet
